messages:
Alex: Morning pulse — quick async standup for kernel/batching/KV bench.
What I did: landed the KV eviction threshold fix, ran a microbatch perf sweep on rtx-8.
Blockers: seeing 5-10% CPU jitter on 2nd-stage kernel scheduling that skews our p50.
Today: iterate on scheduler heuristics + open a CR for kernel change, will ping reviewers. TL;DR: need eyes on kernel PR and a sanity-check on the benchmark run.

Maria: Nice — saw the eviction fix, +1 on tests. I pushed a small tweak to ttl compaction that reduced cold-hit weight. Bench artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/bench/176867/ — numbers attached there.
(quick note) microbatch latencies look stable until sequence len ~1024, then tail climbs.

Sanjay: Re: kernel scheduler jitter — can you paste the perf profile? I suspect syscalls from the monitoring agent might be noisy during the run. If you can reproduce with monitoring disabled we'll know.
Also, I'm free to review the CR after lunch.

Li: I ran a focused KV cache stress test overnight. Results: steady-state hit rate 88% with LRU+prefetch, but eviction churn increases with high prefix overlap. Script:
```
python bench_kv.py --clients 32 --prefix-var 0.6 --duration 600
```
I'll drop the raw CSV in the artifacts folder. Might be worth trying a hot-key policy for prefix-heavy workloads.

Katie: Quick heads-up — the canary job failed once due to OOM on the quantized model runner, but repeated runs passed. I've added a defensive guard to the runner to avoid allocating the entire KV buffer on startup. Small PR: #8342.

Alex: @Sanjay good call — I'll re-run with monitoring off and post the perf flame. @Maria thanks for the artifacts link, will compare with Li's CSV. @Katie I'll take a look at #8342 now.

Sanjay: FYI I instrumented a microbench that pins threads to cores; when pinned the jitter drops ~6%. Might be a decent mitigation for the canary and some dedicated pools. I'll share the patch.

Maria: One more ask — can we standardize the bench invocations? There are small differences in flags across runs which makes side-by-side noisy. Maybe a wrapper script `rbench run` that normalizes env and collects traces. I can sketch it.

dev-bot: buildbot: Kernel-PR-412 passed CI (linux/gpu/torch). Artifact: /artifacts/412/summary.html :thumbsup:

Alex: Great. Action items for today: 1) Alex re-run microbatch with monitoring disabled + upload flame; 2) Sanjay share core-pinning patch; 3) Maria draft rbench wrapper; 4) Li test hot-key eviction policy on prefix-heavy traces; 5) Katie finalize OOM guard PR. If anyone needs pairing time I'm around in #eng-runtime-call.

Maria: I'll start the rbench draft and share a short RFC in the channel later.

Li: I'll run hot-key tests and upload results by EOD.

Katie: Merging #8342 after a quick CI pass. Will post in thread. :rocket:

Alex: Thanks everyone — short thread, but useful. Ping here if anything blocks reviews or I should pause the kernel change.
